title: How to Test AI Agents When No Benchmark Exists — Nathanael Weill, Air Canada
talk_summary: The speaker describes building evaluation sets for agents when no public benchmark exists by inverting the problem: generate inputs from known answers/rules, then check whether the agent recovers the known defect or answer. He emphasizes code-graded checks, invariant/metamorphic tests, template-generated cases, and using expert feedback to improve tests rather than directly patching the agent.

takeaways.technique: Seed known defects and measure recall
takeaways.what_they_do: They generate contracts with planted rule violations or removed clauses, then check whether the agent flags exactly those known problems.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we planted the problem, and we try to find it back
takeaways.numbers: 275 generated tests; one evaluation a week to dozens a day

takeaways.what_they_do: They prefer exact-match or script checks against known labels and avoid LLM-as-judge because its noise can rival the agent's noise.
They change things that should not affect the result—supplier name, address, clause order—and rerun the same input to verify consistent output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can reorder the clause, so some randomness should also lead to the same results

takeaways.what_they_do: They reuse expert contract templates with blanks, generate arrays of values where some break rules and some do not, and know the expected flag from code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: our expert already use templates, so we can reuse them to generate some contracts

takeaways.technique: Mine past PRs and decisions as labels
takeaways.what_they_do: They tried to compare past signed contracts with changed versions and require the agent to reproduce the same flags, though missing originals limited it.

takeaways.technique: Feedback creates tests, not direct agent patches
takeaways.what_they_do: When experts give real feedback, they use it to generate better tests, prompts, and test ideas rather than immediately editing the agent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we don't use this feedback to fix the agent. We use this feedback to generate better test
